examples/arpoon: js-syntax: uses the `add.out` getter-object alignment form; Rudel spells it `add_out` (Koto has no property getters), same as examples_allowlist `freq#1`.
examples/csoundDemo: unsupported: Csound WASM (`loadCsound`, `.csound(...)`) has no native analogue (docs/UNSUPPORTED.md).
examples/dinofunk: unsupported: `setVoicingRange` registers a runtime voicing dictionary, which is `addVoicings` under another name (see examples_allowlist `addVoicings#0`).
examples/loungeSponge: unsupported: Csound WASM (`loadOrc`, `.csound(...)`) as csoundDemo; the tune is written around it.
testtunes/confusedPhone: js-syntax: chains a standalone control function (`transpose(-12).late(0)`) as a value; Rudel's transforms are pattern methods, so there is nothing to chain off the bare function.
testtunes/shapeShifted: legacy-api: bare note-name globals (`e5`, `b4`, `gs2`). Current Strudel does not export these either — these fixtures predate mini-notation strings, and no test in the vendored Strudel runs them.
testtunes/technoDrums: unsupported: Tone.js instruments (`.tone(new MembraneSynth().toDestination())`); Rudel's voices are its own DSP.
testtunes/timeCat: legacy-api: bare note-name globals (`c3`, `eb3`), as shapeShifted.
testtunes/whirlyStrudel: legacy-api: bare note-name globals (`e4`, `b2`), as shapeShifted.
